summary: PPPoE, as described in RFC 2516, limits the negotiated maximum receive unit to 1492 bytes. This informational memo describes a way to relax that limit so larger values can be negotiated, reducing fragmentation in broadband networks where the underlying links can carry bigger frames.

eli5.summary: Some delivery vans were only allowed to carry small boxes even though the road could handle bigger ones. This lets the vans carry bigger boxes, so fewer things need to be chopped up.
